source_labels_and_K2_invariance.K2_transport: A paratopism induces a point bijection between the 3-nets of L and L'. Transport both quantum assignments by that same bijection. Every new row/column/symbol line is an old ONB line, mutual tensor orthogonality is merely reindexed, and each assignment's projective-ray multiset is unchanged. G1-G5 in the draft use only line incidence/Gram supports, so their K2 forms transport as well.
source_labels_and_K2_invariance.caveat: This is existence transport through a classical 3-net, not a claim that arbitrary conjugation is included in the paper's narrower QLS set-isotopy definition. Heavy/G4 derivation and Gram/CNF/UNSAT certification are not checked by this slice.
